titre: toxic reminders for when everyone's out and you have a test monday #studytok #studytips #school #studymotivation
notes: Schéma du label toxic-study-motivation (r 3,17 sur 3 passages, bb2eeefa). Famille d'accroche neuve : le week-end où les autres sortent. Rivalité avec soi-même seulement : on ne juge jamais les amis qui sortent. Accroches écrites : « toxic reminders for when everyone's out and you have a test monday » (retenue : le moment précis, très partagé), « toxic weekend study motivation » (écartée : trop large), « toxic things i tell myself on saturday nights » (écartée : flou). Sept pensées neuves, aucun gros mot. Place micabo : slide 4 (se tester) ; place UnSwipe : slide 6 (les stories). Slides 4 et 6 sans personne. slides.texte_overlay:
toxic reminders for when everyone's out
and you have a test monday

they'll have other saturdays.
you'll have this grade on your report. FOREVER.

you're not missing out.
you're choosing. that's different.

2 hours of testing yourself tonight
= sunday completely free. do the MATH.

monday-you will either thank you or blame you.
there's no third option.

watching their stories won't make you feel better.
put the phone DOWN.

study now, go out next weekend
with zero guilt. that's the real plan.

nobody remembers one saturday.
you'll remember this test. DO IT.
